name: ccmux
description: Drive the ccmux cross-harness CLI to run work on other AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi, Gemini): a `dispatch` skill for programmatic one-shot `ccmux invoke` orchestration, and a `tasks` skill for scaffolding, running, resuming, and tracking persistent `ccmux task` units of work. Requires the ccmux CLI on PATH.
